scope: Retrospective research pilot; not a live or point-in-time trading model
target: Any of the next six month-end cumulative total returns from the signal month is <= -15%; not daily maximum drawdown
lag: All predictor input observations lagged one calendar month for a conservative publication proxy; revised current vintage remains a limitation
flags: Equal-weight count of the four flags. Caution if count >=2. No threshold search.
model: Ridge logistic regression: standardized four features, intercept unpenalized, sum negative log likelihood + 0.5*sum(beta^2); fixed penalty 1, no tuning
train: 1990-01 through 2011-06; six-month purge before fixed 2012 boundary
baseline: Constant training event prevalence on holdout
limit: Overlapping labels, few independent crises, current-vintage revisions, no valuations/earnings, broad market not Nasdaq, monthly not intramonth losses, observational not causal, no 2026 model forecast
